# scm_dlp_ocr_enablement (Data Source)

Retrieves Enterprise DLP OCR enablement state for a target service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the OCR enablement state for a service.
data "scm_dlp_ocr_enablement" "prisma_access" {
  target_service_name = "prisma-access"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `target_service_name` (String) Target service name (e.g. prisma-access, ngfw, dlp).

### Read-Only

- `ocr_enablement` (String) OCR enablement state (REQUESTED, ENABLED, DISABLED).
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant identifier.
- `tfid` (String) Terraform identifier.
